name: nested-agent-file
description: An agent file with allowed_subagents and a maxSubagentDepth setting are accepted: the agent is listed, nothing is refused.
setup:
mkdir -p .pi/agents && printf '%s' '---
description: Delegates to the worker
tools: read
allowed_subagents: worker
---
You delegate.
' > .pi/agents/orchestrator.md

mkdir -p .pi/agents && printf '%s' '---
description: Does the work
tools: read
---
You work.
' > .pi/agents/worker.md
